title: Chapter 2671 - 76: Facing "Death" (Part 4)
content:
Chapter 2671: Chapter 76: Facing "Death" (Part 4)

"This ’Mr. Witch’, truly has a sharp mind and quick calculations..."

Chi Feng sighed inwardly, then couldn’t help but feel a little tempted.

To kill Bi Jie...

But just as he thought of this, from afar, Bi Jie seemed to sense a murderous intent.

Not good!

Bi Jie immediately disregarded mourning Elder Cang and caring for the deceased Bi Fang tribesmen, and instead solemnly commanded:

"Bi Fang Tribe, heed my order, everyone gather your formations and protect me!"

The barbarian soldiers of the Bi Fang Tribe came to their senses from their astonishment and immediately followed the order, forming a formation with Bi Jie securely protected in the center.

The remaining two elders also stayed by Bi Jie’s side, guarding against anyone rushing in to kill their Young Master.

The chance to kill Bi Jie was lost again.

Mo Hua clicked his tongue, then felt a bit puzzled in his heart.

This Young Master of the Bi Jie Tribe seemed too sensitive to murderous intent.

Almost as soon as he spoke, ready to call people to surround and kill Bi Jie, the latter had already sensed it.

Meanwhile, Bi Jie’s gaze flickered uncertainly, feeling apprehensive:

"Who exactly, has repeatedly been moving murderous intent, trying to find an opportunity to harm me?"

"Is it Dan Zhu? Could he truly have such malicious thoughts?"

Bi Jie was a bit perplexed.

The situation had temporarily reached a deadlock.

The Danque Tribe was brewing murderous intent.

The Bi Fang Tribe was on high alert.

No one dared to make a move, but neither dared to be careless.

The Bi Fang Tribe had suffered greatly, losing as many as two Golden Core Elders, and naturally did not dare to act recklessly.

While the Danque Tribe, although now possessing a superior strength, without the ability to ambush and kill Bi Jie, had no reason for a frontal conflict with the Bi Fang Tribe.

After a moment’s pause, Bi Jie was slightly moved and said to Dan Zhu:

"We agreed to not disturb each other’s territory and remain peaceful."

"Now, your Danque Tribe can go inside to rescue. Our Bi Fang Tribe will not obstruct you."

Dan Zhu frowned.

He was kind-hearted and lacking in experience, but not a fool.

Having spent time with Mo Hua, Dan Zhu was becoming increasingly aware of "insidious" thoughts, and how could he not know that Bi Jie was setting a trap for him.

Within the Stone Palace, lurked an indescribable terrifying crisis, even the Golden Core Elders of the Bi Fang Tribe would die without a burial place inside.

What good can the Danque Tribe reap?

As the Young Master, he certainly couldn’t risk his neck.

Sending Chi Feng, Ba Shan, and Bachuan, the three Golden Cores of the Danque Tribe into the Stone Palace, Dan Zhu also felt uneasy.

Even if the Stone Palace were safe, these three Golden Cores might not return safely.

During the time these three Golden Cores entered the Stone Palace, Bi Jie would certainly find a way to kill him.

This was the awareness of "life born from adversity" that Mr. Witch mentioned to him.

Constantly prioritizing his own life and guarding against wrongdoers he encounters who might harm him.

Dan Zhu firmly remembered.

Thus, for now, he could only hold back his troops.

Leaving the Stone Palace was not an option; without rescuing people, they would allow the Bi Fang Tribe to act as they please.

Entering the Stone Palace was also impossible.

The Stone Palace was a hazardous place, even Golden Cores faced nine deaths to one life.

The deadlock was untenable, Dan Zhu knew this well.

Just at that moment, a heavy yet gentle voice came:

"Let me go inside..."

Dan Zhu was taken aback, turned to look at Mo Hua, and said incredulously, "Mr. Witch, you..."

Mo Hua had a solemn and serious expression, but carried a heroic spirit of courageously facing death, with a bold and generous air.

He spoke with heavy tone:

"I can sense that within the Stone Palace ahead, hides an enemy of a Divine Lord, a heresy against the deity."

"As a shaman, it is my duty to eradicate evil objects, to sweep away wickedness, and spread the Divine Lord’s grace, I... though I die without regret..."

After saying this, Mo Hua slightly raised his head, looking at the sky, his face showing a firm but tragic sentiment.

The members of the Bi Fang Tribe looked at Mo Hua, and all were emotionally shaken, speechless.

Ba Shan and Bachuan also involuntarily felt a sense of admiration blossoming in their hearts.

Even Barbarian General Chi Feng felt his heart tremble, developing a sincere respect for this "Mr. Witch," who he had not thought much of previously.
